segments.oily: One reviewer with combination/acne-prone skin reports the serum reduced oil production and made makeup last longer, while another says it left skin feeling glossy and oily with irritation after two uses.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report resolved dullness, uneven tone, less tightness and improved barrier function, though one dry-skin reviewer says it did nothing for winter dryness or barrier issues.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report a light, airy after-feel, reduced redness, smaller-looking pores and no breakouts even when acne-prone.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive or reactive skin mostly report no irritation, calmer and more hydrated skin, and reduced redness, but a few sensitive reviewers report a chemical burn, fragrance sensitivity, or irritation.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature skin (50s) report a more even, flawless, glowing look and reduced wrinkle appearance from early use.
segments.normal: One reviewer says the serum did nothing extra for already healthy, hydrated skin beyond a temporary glow.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for wrinkles report reduced appearance of fine lines and a brighter, more even look; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report significant hydration, plumping and a glass-skin glow, sometimes within one week; one reviewer says it gave only temporary hydration with no lasting difference and another says it didn't fix winter dryness or barrier weakness.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers report visibly reduced redness over one to several weeks; a small number instead report new or worsened redness alongside breakouts.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers, including one on prescription retinoids and one with eczema, report improved barrier comfort and no irritation; one reviewer explicitly says it did not help her compromised barrier.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report brightened, reduced dark spots, post-acne marks and hyperpigmentation over one to two weeks, with no dissent reported.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and calming of hormonal acne or scars; however, multiple other reviewers, several self-identifying as acne-prone, report new whiteheads, cystic acne or fungal-acne-like breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer reports reduced oil production and longer-lasting makeup; another reports skin turning glossy/oily and irritated after use.

extraits.texte: This serum really surprised me. I tend to be wary of skincare products that are hyper-viral and trendy on the internet since they seem to be gimmicky. However, I was on the hunt for a new peptide serum after running out of a high-end peptide serum that was running me $80 a bottle. The claims seemed similar and the medicube was at a much more affordable price point, so I figured there's be no risk in trying it out. I fell in love with this serum right away! I have very dry skin so I looove serums that aren't too watery and have substance, and the jelly-like texture of this serum is perfect. It's not too heavy or greasy, but just thick enough that it feels hydrating on the skin. After using my first bottle, I noticed a few changes that I'm really happy with. Due to my dry skin, I often struggle with dullness and uneven tone. Additionally, my skin is dry and sensitive to the point that my skin barrier is prone to damage. The barrier weakness is compounded by the fact that I am on a prescription retinoid, so I try to prevent that by using super hydrating serums and creams. I have definitely noticed a positive change in both my skin barrier and tone after using my first bottle- my skin is plumped, soft, and glowy, my texture and tone are so much more even, and I no longer wake up in the morning with bone-dry, itchy, tight skin despite using heavy creams and occlusives at night. In all honesty, this serum was much more effective than the high-end serum that is 4x more expensive! I

Skin type: combination and sensitive. I've been using the Medicube PDRN Pink Peptide Serum for two weeks and I'm really impressed with how comforting and lightweight it feels on my skin. The texture absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness, and it gives a natural glow that looks healthy, not greasy. I usually react to new products, but this serum didn't cause irritation or breakouts, even when paired with niacinamide. My skin feels calmer, softer and more hydrated, especially on the areas where I get dryness. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup with no pilling. The results are more noticeable with consistent use — especially the plump, smooth feeling. Overall, it makes my skin look more even, glowy and comfortable, which is exactly what I wanted from a peptide serum.
